# Travel Notice: Maya Patel, Germany

## Travel details

Traveller: Maya Patel (maya.patel), Sales, UK office.

Destination: Germany.

Travel dates: 2026-10-02 to 2026-10-04, inclusive.

Purpose: customer meetings. Maya will take her assigned company laptop, LT-MPATEL, for meeting preparation, email and access to company work while away. The notice covers this journey only. A change in country, dates or laptop must be sent to Security before the changed arrangements are used.

## Approval and acknowledgement

Callum Reeves (callum.reeves) approved the trip on 2026-09-25. The business purpose and travel dates were confirmed with the traveller. No additional system permissions were requested as part of this notice.

Thomas Price (thomas.price) acknowledged the travel notice for Security on 2026-09-25. His note: sign-ins from Germany on 2026-10-02 to 2026-10-04 are expected for Maya Patel. Use LT-MPATEL as the expected company laptop when checking activity during this period.

## Instructions to the traveller

Use the normal company sign-in process and MFA. Reach internal systems through the VPN gateway as required by the Remote Access and VPN Policy. Keep the laptop under your control and report any loss to the helpdesk the same day.

Security may contact Maya through an established contact route if a sign-in needs clarification. This notice supplies travel context; it does not establish that every action during the trip was performed by Maya. Activity outside the stated dates or from a different device needs its own checks. All recorded contact or sign-in times associated with this notice are to be expressed in UTC.
